'''Mickey''' (Japanese: '''ミキ''' ''Miki'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP176|Ariados, Amigos]]''. She is a student at the [[Pokémon Jujitsu Academy]].

Mickey took the Red classes of the Academy which studies battle techniques. She had a battle with {{OBP|Ralph|EP176}} and lost.
